summary: Frontend E2E testing completed against the preview URL. Sign-in with admin@gmail.com/Admin@1234 works, /projects renders 3 seeded workflow cards with no 'Could not load / authentication required' banner, clicking 'Open project' successfully navigates to /projects/prj_ffd4c679 with the full KPI strip (LIVE PERIOD, CURRENCY, STATUS, ITEMS) visible — the reported 'not able to open the page' bug is fixed. Sidebar nav 01/02/09 all load without 401. Global search palette opens via Ctrl+K and via statusbar-search-trigger; typing 'sohar' returns exactly 1 Workflow project (Sohar Solar Farm); Save filter adds the 'sohar' chip under Saved filters. Primary enterprise blue (#2457c5) is applied to CTAs.

issues: Button alignment across the three project cards is inconsistent: on the 'Abu Dhabi 400kV Substation' card (whose title wraps to 2 lines) the 'Open project' button sits closer to the left/center, while on Fujairah LNG and Sohar Solar cards it sits bottom-right. Recommend using a consistent flex/justify-end footer row inside each pcard so 'Open project' is always bottom-right regardless of title height.

Floating 'RFQ workflow ›' pill anchored mid-viewport on the right edge feels visually detached from the content grid and can overlap card actions on narrower widths — consider anchoring it to the header row or the page footer.

The 'workflow-project-card-<id>' data-testid appears to be missing on individual project cards (only workflow-project-list wrapper exists). Adding per-card testids and an 'open-project-<id>' testid would harden E2E targeting; today we had to fall back to text selectors.

action_items: Normalize card footer layout so 'Open project' is bottom-right on every workflow-project card (fix multi-line title case).
Add data-testid='workflow-project-card-<id>' and data-testid='open-project-<id>' to each card for stable E2E hooks.
Reposition or restyle the floating 'RFQ workflow' shortcut so it doesn't overlap card actions.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.tsx still ships demo credentials in the bundle — acceptable for internal preview but should be behind an env flag before any external release.
api.ts 401 -> /login redirect is good; ensure the redirect only fires for authenticated routes so the /login page itself doesn't loop when the bootstrap ping returns 401.
seed_data_creation: None — used the 3 seeded workflow projects (Abu Dhabi 400kV Substation, Fujairah LNG Terminal, Sohar Solar Farm).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Supervisor now runs the real services (backend + frontend both RUNNING). Preview URL https://560cbcb5-94d1-45d9-bab9-dcb8cfc9a201.preview.emergentagent.com is healthy (/api/health = 200). All 6 requested frontend scenarios pass. Only remaining feedback is cosmetic (button alignment on the first card with a 2-line title, and floating RFQ workflow pill position).
rca of the issue: The originally reported 'after sign-in not able to open the page' bug is resolved: 401s no longer leave the user on a broken 'authentication required' state — api.ts unwrap() now redirects to /login, session cookie is set correctly on login, and /projects/:id renders the full detail screen after clicking Open project.
